text:
Harper J: Frustrated we keep chasing old actions. Proposal: a tiny 2-week remediation scaffold (single place to update, short metadata, required verification) + an IC buddy rotation so follow-ups don't stall.

Noah D: 👍 Sounds good. What does the scaffold look like? Keep it compact plz.

Harper J: Draft scaffold below — useable as a ticket or board card. Intentionally terse so updates are 1-2 lines.

Harper J: ```
Remediation scaffold (2w)
- Incident: INC-####
- Owner / Buddy: <owner> / <buddy>
- Priority: P0|P1|P2
- Objective (one line): <what we aim to fix>
- Start / Due: YYYY-MM-DD / YYYY-MM-DD
- Blast radius: small|medium|large
- Rollback window: HH:MM
- Telemetry anchors: <metric link> (what we watch)
- Tasks (tiny, owner + ETA):
  - [ ] <task> — owner — ETA
- Verification (pass criteria + duration): e.g. p95 < 150ms for 72h
- Recurrence notes: X in last 6mo (tags: config|infra|deploy|model|third-party)
- Blocking deps: <team/vendor> — owner
- Comms snippet: one-liner status + contact
- Escalate-if-not-closed-by: YYYY-MM-DD (auto-creates roadmap jump-ticket)
```

Zoe K: Love "telemetry anchors" phrasing. Two tweaks: 1) require a single monitoring query link in Telemetry anchors; 2) require a 1-line handoff checklist for the buddy to sign off.

Harper J: Agree. Add "Handoff checklist" small field: links to logs, temporary mitigations, runbook section.

Noah D: For IC rotation, propose "IC buddy rotation": primary leads week 1, buddy leads week 2 and closes remediation or escalates. Publish rotation schedule in playbook + calendar. Helps cross-training.

Harper J: Proposed cadence:
- D0: incident channel + immediate mitigation notes
- D1: postmortem draft + create remediation scaffold cards for short actions (2w)
- Week1 (Tue 10:00): 15-min remediation heartbeat (owners update cards)
- Week2 (Tue 10:00): final verification review — close or escalate to roadmap
- Monthly: 30-min recurrence review to inspect root-cause tags

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: #eng-oncall remediation-heartbeat Tue 10:00 recurring starting 1827012600

Zoe K: Automation idea: postmortem parser looks for lines starting with "Remediation:" and auto-populates a scaffold card. Start with a Google Sheet template + webhook if needed.

Noah D: Prioritization hint: if Blast radius=large OR Recurrence>2, escalate immediately to PM with a proposed timeline. Otherwise keep in 2w lane.

Harper J: Minimal verification checklist example (to be copied into each card):
- Reproduce locally / staging: yes/no
- Deploy plan: canary/ff/revert-ready
- Telemetry: baseline + 72h watch linked
- Post-change smoke checks: list

Zoe K: Quick comms snippet template for stakeholders: "Status: In progress. Owner: X. Risk: low/med/high. ETA: YYYY-MM-DD. Monitoring: <link>. Contact: @X"

Noah D: Actions:
- Zoe K: build google-sheet prototype & scaffold template (due 4d)
- Harper J: update incident playbook with IC buddy rotation and escalation rule (due 1w)
- Noah D: draft small postmortem->card automation sketch (due 1w)
- Ops: add remediation-heartbeat recurring reminder (ops-bot)

Zoe K: I'll post the sheet link and an example card once ready. Also I'll add example queries for Telemetry anchors so teams have a template.

Harper J: One operational guardrail: only put items into the 2w scaffold that are expected to complete in 2 weeks. Anything larger should be routed to roadmap with a PM. Keeps the lane healthy.

Noah D: Also recommend a "verify owner" on each card: if buddy doesn't sign off by the end of week 2, auto-assign escalation.

ops-bot: Reminder created: remediation-heartbeat recurring starting 1827012600

Zoe K: +1 to pilot. I'll take the first pilot card on the next incident. Harper, can you shepherd the playbook change?

Harper J: Yep, I'll open a tiny PR and ping reviewers. Closing thread — will report back after prototype is live.
